research_reading_guide.title: Start with exact DNA pieces
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: The first searches found repeated pieces and repeated spacing. Biological labels were added afterward. This tests the method on specific cases; it does not establish a universal instruction set.

research_reading_guide.title: Ask what exact matching misses
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: A biologically important region was not recovered as a shared exact word. The next question was whether some positions could vary while useful structure remained.

research_reading_guide.title: Allow two positions to vary
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: The masked representation compares 16-base spans while holding 14 positions fixed. Its candidate vocabulary and sampled occurrences are recorded separately from biological meaning.

research_reading_guide.title: Separate location from function
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: Some patterns recur near gene boundaries. Tests of matching neighboring components and detailed geometry failed. Being in a similar neighborhood is not proof of doing the same job.

research_reading_guide.title: Try new tokens and new genomes
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: A separate token sample weakened confidence in broad replication. Held-out genome tests supported specific boundary-role predictions. Both results remain visible.

research_reading_guide.title: Challenge the model with stronger controls
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: Panel 2 supported transfer under its original tests. Adding composition and mask controls preserved some findings and weakened others. The original tests and later challenges are different records.

research_reading_guide.title: Keep successes and failures together
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: Panel 3 supported several broad boundary-role tests. General wildcard-parameter rules and universal lineage-distance rules failed their tests. Those failures constrain the next model.

research_reading_guide.title: Check whether repeated letters explain the signal
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: Low-complexity patterns remain in the dataset. Later entropy challenges weakened some interpretations. These are retrospective checks, not replacements for the earlier frozen outcomes.

research_reading_guide.title: See exactly what is still untested
research_reading_guide.plain_explanation: Model v3 was developed using all 20 observed genomes. Its fresh-panel predictions remain frozen and untested in this archive. That development score is not a fresh validation result.
